title: platform standup - 2026-04-09
content:
Attendees: Maya, Aisha, Ben, Diego (remote), Rahul (notes)

Yesterday / Done:
- Control plane: merged canary switch for model routing policy (PR 472). Canary on 10% traffic for eu-west region. Initial smoke tests green.
- Routing: added weighted fallback route for low-memory nodes; config flag `routing.weighted_fallback` enabled in staging.
- Auth: rolled out short-lived token path for internal service-to-service calls; integration tests passed for token rotation baseline.
- Quotas: prototype enforcement hook implemented for per-customer token quotas; emits metric `quotas.enforcement.attempts`.
- Infra: increased API gateway connection pool for dedicated cluster (to reduce 502 spikes).

Today / Plan:
- Control plane: monitor canary metrics for latency and error-rate (Aisha). Watch 95p and 99p latency, and model mismatch errors. If error-rate > 0.5% over 15m -> rollback.
- Routing: finalize metrics span for routing decisions (Ben) so we can attribute latency to route selection. Instrumentation PR queued.
- Auth: prepare ops runbook for token rotation edge cases (Maya + Diego). Add recovery steps when KMS is temporarily unavailable.
- Quotas: finish unit tests and add integration to staging (Diego). Start a small smoke test using test-tenant `qa-quota-1`.
- Postmortem follow-up: assign owners for items from last week's 1-hour outage (Rahul to consolidate).

Blockers / Risks:
- Quotas enforcement: rate-limiter library shows a race under high-concurrency; reproducing in load test but needs deeper debugging. Risk: throttling customers unexpectedly. (Diego)
- Canary monitoring: current dashboards don't surface model variant skews vs. baseline; missing a couple critical signals for safe rollout. Need quick dashboard patch. (Aisha)
- Auth: KMS team flagged a planned maintenance window tomorrow that could affect key fetch latency - we need to sequence token rotation jobs around that. Ops currently evaluating.

Notes / Discussions:
- Canary threshold: agreed to keep canary at 10% for 2 hours if error < 0.2% and 99p latency delta < 20ms. If either condition violated, auto-rollback to 0% and alert SRE on call.
- Routing policy experiment: proposal to test latency-preferring routing vs. cost-preferring routing for background batch workloads. Ben to draft experiment plan; target start next week.
- Quotas UX: product flagged that hard quota rejections should include clear error codes and docs for SDKs - add to backlog.
- Observability: add `quotas.enforcement.attempts` and `quotas.rejected` to the per-tenant dashboard; set alert when rejection rate > 0.1% sustained 30m.

Action Items (owners):
- Aisha: implement quick dashboard patch for canary signals + create alert runbook. Due: 2026-04-09 EOD.
- Ben: open PR for routing metrics instrumentation and link to experiment doc. Due: 2026-04-10.
- Diego: debug race in rate-limiter lib and add mitigation (fallback token-bucket). Due: 2026-04-12.
- Maya + Diego: draft auth runbook for token rotation + KMS outage handling. Due: 2026-04-10.
- Rahul: compile outage postmortem action list and owners; share by EOD.

Quick logs / snippets:
- Smoke test notes: staging canary results: 0 errors (1h), 95p +2ms vs baseline, 99p +18ms. Good to expand to prod canary.
- Load test: quotas load test hit race at ~1200 concurrent req/s for a single tenant; reproduction case attached to JIRA-INF-2341.

Meeting adjourned 09:45 PST

Notes to self: keep a separate checklist for canary rollouts (health checks -> traffic ramp -> hold window -> monitoring) - add to control-plane runbook.
